    - paragraph
      - StaticText "Hugging a beam at the top of the hatch, Mai looked out and her breath stopped. The boat had heeled so steeply that all she saw was an enormous wall of black-green water bearing down."
    - paragraph
      - StaticText "She shut her eyes, opened them again — now the gunwale had crested the water, the ocean completely vanished."
    - StaticText "A body collided into hers, slammed her against the side of the hatch door."
    - StaticText "Other bodies — she was on top of them — thighs and ribs and arms and heads — jammed this way and that with each groaning tilt,"
